source_packet_summary.reason_packet_not_checked_in: The generated packet is reproducible metadata only; the read records the checked-in refs and summary without adding another fixture.

case_triage_reads.overtrust_risk: medium: the brief is readable and commercially concrete, so caveats must stay close to the private-pilot and buyer-proof language.
case_triage_reads.source_depth_read: Checked-in-safe sources are adequate for a caveated offline brief, but buyer reality, investor or recruiting signal, and private context remain compressed.
case_triage_reads.private_context_dependency: Private context could change confidence about public-launch upside, but the checked-in artifacts still preserve the decision and action-consequence shape.
case_triage_reads.high_stakes_domain_risk: not_evaluated: the checked-in sources do not make this a legal, clinical, or safety-domain decision.
case_triage_reads.lost_value_or_overcorrection_risk: medium: public-launch signal, fundraising, recruiting, and larger-buyer proof remain possible lost value rather than resolved findings.
what_downstream_agent_should_inspect_fir: whether private buyer context supports the paid scoped pilot gate
whether the larger-logo prospect was treated as evidence or status signal

case_triage_reads.overtrust_risk: medium_to_high: a clean operating-gate brief can sound deployment-ready unless clinical workflow, compliance, and patient-risk caveats remain visible.
case_triage_reads.source_depth_read: The brief is adequate for offline inspection, but checked-in-safe context cannot verify backlog cause, admin capacity, compliance tolerance, or patient safety boundaries.
case_triage_reads.private_context_dependency: Private and domain context may not change the narrow-pilot direction, but it could change whether any user-facing or operational summary is appropriate.
case_triage_reads.high_stakes_domain_risk: domain_review_recommended: healthcare workflow and compliance stakes require domain/legal/compliance calibration before user-facing confidence.
case_triage_reads.lost_value_or_overcorrection_risk: medium: compressing a larger gate list may lose patient-trust, consent, measurement, support, or auditability controls.
what_downstream_agent_should_inspect_fir: whether the 48-hour backlog diagnostic is supported by local evidence
whether the four must-pass gates preserve patient and compliance constraints
whether sales language stays limited to scheduling and billing routing

case_triage_reads.overtrust_risk: high: authority-transfer language can sound like operating advice unless legal, governance, founder-relationship, and source-depth limits remain prominent.
case_triage_reads.source_depth_read: The cofounder brief is useful for inspection but too sensitive for ordinary user-facing confidence from checked-in-safe artifacts alone.
case_triage_reads.private_context_dependency: Private context may not overturn the action-consequence shape, but it could materially change relationship cost, legal posture, board/equity constraints, and timing.
case_triage_reads.high_stakes_domain_risk: requires_domain_review: governance, legal, employment, equity, board, and customer-continuity implications are not resolved by the brief.
case_triage_reads.lost_value_or_overcorrection_risk: high: founder dignity, relationship repair, team loyalty, customer trust, and continuity through founder knowledge remain unresolved possible losses.
what_downstream_agent_should_inspect_fir: whether the COO alignment and authority-transfer steps are legally and governance-safe
whether the transition role preserves customer continuity without hidden authority
whether relationship and founder-dignity costs are underweighted

cross_case_triage_pattern.summary: The provisional triage layer usefully separates ordinary caveated brief candidates from domain-review and high-overtrust cases without deciding correctness.
cross_case_triage_pattern.stable_signal: All three cases preserve action-consequence clarity and non-claims, but they route differently based on source depth, domain stakes, and overtrust risk.
cross_case_triage_pattern.source_depth_pattern: Checked-in-safe context is enough for offline inspection, not enough for runtime attachment or customer-facing confidence.
cross_case_triage_pattern.human_calibration_pattern: Human calibration remains deferred and required before stronger user-surface or product claims.
cross_case_triage_pattern.runtime_pattern: Runtime attachment remains blocked for all three cases.

runtime_attachment_read.rationale: The system has offline evidence, deterministic builders, and provisional triage, but no human calibration, no runtime contract, no prompt integration, and no proof that the advice is correct.

user_surface_read.rationale: Launch-beta may be a caveated brief candidate, deploy-intake needs domain/compliance review, and cofounder governance should remain not-ready for ordinary user-facing confidence.

agent_inspection_read.rationale: The reads can orient downstream inspection toward source depth, overtrust, domain review, and lost-value concerns, but they do not authorize action.

strongest_useful_signal: Automatic triage can route the same enriched-brief surface differently across GTM, healthcare operations, and founder-governance cases while preserving source limits and non-claims.
strongest_unresolved_risk: The triage read is Codex-assisted and checked-in-safe; raw/private context, domain/legal calibration, and real human review remain unresolved.
